notes: Choice Multi 65 program for mixed-use and multi-residential (2–15 units). 1-year term up to 65% LTV, minimum Beacon 550. No income requirement or TDS. DSCR 1:1 (rents must cover mortgage, taxes, and utilities if applicable). Maximum loan $3,000,000, sliding scale above $1,500,000. Appraisal from approved list. May require inspection at commitment. Available in GTA, Ottawa, London, and other major Ontario markets.
